name: Valossa Assistant
description: Valossa Assistant brings multimodal video and audio understanding, search and clipping features into Claude. Connect your Valossa account and ask questions about audio-visual content across your video library in plain language: find the moment a topic comes up, pull a transcript or summary, surface the best soundbites and highlights, list shots and visual scenes, and export ready-to-use clips. It's powered by Valossa's proprietary Gen-7 engine — not a GPT wrapper — which analyzes seven modalities at once — speech, visuals, audio events, on-screen text, faces, moods, and structure — and flags sensitive content. Video and audio uploads go straight to Valossa (never through the model's context), and analysis runs on your account's quota. EU-based and GDPR-compliant: your uploaded content is stored and processed in the EEA and is not used to train Valossa's AI models (unless you opt in). Built for media teams, creators, researchers, and developers who want agent-native video workflows and content intelligence.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Valossa Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Valossa Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-assistant.valossa.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Valossa Assistant MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Valossa Assistant lists 18 MCP tools, including ask_question, commit_video_upload, export_clip, get_best_soundbites, get_clip_download_url, get_quota_status, get_speech_transcript, get_video_highlights, get_video_overview, get_video_saved_clips, get_video_shots, and get_video_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Valossa Assistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Valossa Assistant in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.

_published_faq.name: Does Valossa Assistant MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Valossa Assistant requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Valossa Assistant is developed by Valossa Labs Oy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
